features.title: Crafted for distinction, Nest desks provide privacy and refined aesthetics, making every executive space feel exclusive.
With clean lines, a natural wood finish, and metal legs, Nest delivers a minimalist yet refined look for modern executive spaces
Built tough for busy offices, Nest’s durable work surface withstands everyday demands while maintaining its refined aesthetic.
Nest desks feature an integrated pedestal with a drawer and cabinet, giving you easy access to essentials without cluttering your space.
A smart solution for smaller offices, Nest deliver under-desk storage and streamlined structure that keeps work areas clutter-free.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
